question: Does withholding a candidate also prevent useful future training, and does correcting that loss survive the actually deployed observer? Compare on existing public and late development streams. No new test-device claim.
fixed_evidence: Check original seed-17 weights and actual per-round predictions against gas-native-feedback. At most one already trained official mixed candidate per opportunity, 16 fit and 16 holdout from the previous 32 labels, 7 Adam steps. Compare original, always-mixed, historical confirmed (training starts at deployed), detached (training always advances along the archived always-mixed trajectory, publication compares latest candidate with deployed using identical recent correct-count rule), and detached-allow-tie. The last arm allows equal confirm hits. No thresholds selected on outcomes.
attribution: Before revealing each batch's labels save raw predictions for each path and compare them after substituting only its current native vote into the identical recommended ObserverErrors implementation, one independent observer history for each arm, 32 same prior labels. Reproduce historical raw controls and official recommended calibrated baseline exactly, compare to original paper-adapted shared observer. Score after issuing all rows. Per opportunity, post hoc score the local candidate against its own previous deployed version on the same next service batch; explicitly separate direct rejection loss from downstream training changes. Training costs 63/49 previous steps per native policy, no extra gradient updates for this paired replay. Fixed checks relate to native budget; old recommendation also uses its own historical source-side experiments, disclose difference.
decision: Development eligibility only if public and late both improve recommended output AND best shared-observer fixed recipe by >=.01 pooled Macro-F1, worst recall loss <=.02 versus each. If not, no public option/default change. If yes, reproduce through the ordinary entry, repeat over feedback draws, then test a fresh compatible stream before recommendation. Otherwise use the evidence to choose the next change to the complete product.
